verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents layout-aware OCR that turns PDFs with complex layouts into clean markdown, text, or JSON. One hands-on community report says it handled a complex-layout document far better than open-source parsers. However, the evidence never specifically addresses multi-column reading order, header/footer handling, or footnotes. missing for 10: documented handling of multi-column reading order, header/footer removal or tagging, footnote handling, independent accuracy benchmarks on these layout features

support.subject: As a developer, the API parses complex real-world PDFs — multi-column layouts, headers, footers, footnotes — into clean, correctly ordered content

citations.quote: layout-aware OCR that turns PDFs, scans, tables, and charts into clean markdown, text, or JSON
Turn even the most complex layouts, tables, charts, handwriting, checkboxes, and images into clean markdown
with layout-aware accuracy that generic OCR and PDF-to-text tools can’t match
A user tried LlamaParse and was impressed by the result on a document with a complex layout.
